title: Microcomb spectral fingerprinting enables parts-per-trillion methane detection with low humidity cross-sensitivity
abstract: Optical frequency combs have transformed molecular spectroscopy by enabling broadband, high-resolution analysis, yet they are conventionally used as light sources to interrogate external samples. Here, we introduce an integrated microcomb sensing architecture that unifies resonantly enhanced evanescent sensing with multiwavelength molecular fingerprinting in a single ultrahigh-quality-factor silica microresonator. Gaseous analytes interact directly with the evanescent field of light recirculating within the resonator, enhancing sensitivity while encoding analyte-induced perturbations across the microcomb's collective spectral response. Rather than relying on a single optical resonance, we exploit distributed responses across multiple comb lines to generate multidimensional molecular fingerprints. Adding more comb lines systematically improves analyte discrimination, showing that the microcomb provides sensing information beyond what individual spectral channels offer. Using methane as a model analyte, we achieve an estimated detection limit of 178 parts per trillion, with minimal spectral responses to ammonia, carbon monoxide, hexane, and water vapor at relative humidities up to 90%. By replacing physically long interaction paths with resonant light recirculation in an ultrahigh-Q microresonator, this architecture brings compact optical sensing into the parts-per-trillion regime while exploiting distributed spectral information for chemical identification.

summaries.en: The paper presents an integrated microcomb-based optical sensing architecture that uses resonantly enhanced evanescent interaction in an ultrahigh-Q silica microresonator and multiwavelength spectral fingerprinting to detect methane at an estimated 178 parts per trillion with low humidity and cross-sensitivity to several other gases.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出了一种基于微频梳的集成光学传感架构：在超高Q二氧化硅微谐振器中利用共振增强的倏逝场直接相互作用，并结合多波长光谱指纹实现甲烷约178 parts per trillion的检测，同时在高达90%相对湿度下对氨、二氧化碳、一氧化碳、己烷和水蒸气等表现出较低的交叉响应与湿度敏感性。

title: Charge-Selective Displacement of Spatiotemporal Optical Vortices at a Spatially Uniform Time Boundary
abstract: At a spatially uniform, in-plane-isotropic time boundary, the transverse displacement of a spatiotemporal optical vortex changes sign with its topological charge, despite a charge-independent conversion weight. Radial spectral filtering couples to the vortex phase while preserving identical converted spectral intensities for opposite charges. For a narrow scalar Gaussian spectrum, the displacement follows the logarithmic slope of the spectral weight and occurs with zero mean transverse momentum. In a finite pumped GaAs waveguide, unequal attenuation during extraction adds angular deflection. Independent Maxwell--Drude simulations test this extraction-induced response and give $\pm42$~mrad before detector filtering. Calculated centroid traces at multiple planes separate propagation-induced drift from position offsets.

summaries.en: The paper shows that at a spatially uniform, isotropic time boundary spatiotemporal optical vortices experience a transverse displacement whose sign depends on the vortex topological charge, governed by radial spectral filtering that preserves equal converted intensities for opposite charges, with simulations in a GaAs waveguide attributing any extraction-induced angular deflection and using centroid traces to distinguish propagation drift from position offsets.
summaries.zh: 论文表明，在空间均匀且面内各向同性的时间边界上，时空光涡的横向位移会随拓扑电荷的符号而改变；尽管转换权重与电荷无关，径向谱滤波会耦合到涡旋相位并保持相反电荷的转换谱强度相同，在有限抽运的GaAs波导中，提取过程中的不等衰减会产生角度偏转，独立的Maxwell–Drude仿真并结合多平面质心轨迹来区分传播漂移与位置偏移。

title: Boosting fluorescence and polarization with nanophotonics for single-molecule chiral sensing
abstract: Detecting chirality is essential in chemistry and biomedicine. Circular dichroism identifies chiral molecules through their differential absorption of circularly polarized light. However, its sensitivity is limited by vanishing absorption at low concentrations. Fluorescence-based methods have already enabled other optical techniques to reach the single-molecule limit and could, in principle, also extend chiral detection to reach this sensitivity regime. They are marred, however, by the combination of weak fluorescence signals and low polarization contrast. To overcome these limitations, we leverage high-index dielectric nanophotonics to simultaneously enhance both fluorescence and polarization for chiral sensing. We propose a reciprocity-based analytical framework for a chiral dipolar emitter coupled to a nanoantenna and reveal the different contributions and trade-offs governing the enhancement of circularly polarized fluorescence. Guided by this insight, we tailor achiral dielectric nanostructures to reach a 1000-fold enhancement of fluorescence intensity together with a 10-fold increase in polarization. Crucially, we show that accounting for extrinsic polarization effects in the angular emission patterns of nanophotonic structures is indispensable for reliable enantiomer discrimination. Our approach opens a realistic path for single-molecule chiral sensing.
subjects: Optics (physics.optics) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall); Chemical Physics (physics.chem-ph)

summaries.en: The paper proposes high-index dielectric nanophotonics and a reciprocity-based framework to simultaneously boost fluorescence intensity and polarization contrast for single-molecule chiral sensing, achieving 1000-fold fluorescence enhancement and 10-fold polarization increase while emphasizing that extrinsic polarization effects in emission patterns are crucial for reliable enantiomer discrimination.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出基于高折射率介电纳米光子学与基于互易性的分析框架，能够同时增强单分子手性传感所需的荧光强度和偏振对比度，实验与分析实现了荧光强度1000倍提升并使偏振度提高10倍，同时指出纳米光子结构角向发射中的外禀偏振效应必须被考虑，才能实现可靠的对映体区分。

title: Dynamic Hotspot Migration and Self-Induced Resonances in Ultrafast Laser-Irradiated Silicon Thin Films
abstract: The spatial distribution of energy in silicon thin films under femtosecond laser irradiation is demonstrated to be influenced by the interaction between carrier-induced refractive index modulation and self-induced Fabry-Pérot resonances. We resolve three characteristic excitation regions such as interface-localized, binodal and multi-nodal regimes considering the analysis of silicon-on-insulator (SOI) configurations across thicknesses of 100, 230, and 350 nm. We report a nonlinear hotspot migration effect where the transient reduction of the refractive index stretches the internal standing wave, translating intensity antinodes toward the film volume during the pulse. Numerical results demonstrate that at higher fluences, plasma-induced extinction suppresses internal reflections, triggering a transition from resonance-mediated absorption to plasma shielding. These findings establish a physical basis for depth-resolved modification in laser nanomanufacturing, providing a dual-capacity for simultaneous surface patterning and depth-resolved subsurface modification with direct applications in laser-assisted interfacial separation and 3D integrated photonic fabrication.
subjects: Optics (physics.optics) ; Materials Science (cond-mat.mtrl-sci); Other Condensed Matter (cond-mat.other)

summaries.en: The paper shows that in femtosecond-laser–irradiated silicon thin films, carrier-driven refractive-index changes interact with self-induced Fabry–Pérot resonances to create distinct excitation regimes and cause nonlinear hotspot migration that shifts intensity antinodes into the film, while increasing fluence leads to plasma extinction and a transition from resonance-mediated absorption to plasma shielding, enabling depth-resolved laser nanomanufacturing for applications such as interfacial separation and 3D integrated photonic fabrication.
summaries.zh: 论文表明，在飞秒激光照射的硅薄膜中，载流子诱导的折射率调制与自激发的法布里-珀罗共振相互作用会产生不同的激发区域，并引发非线性热点迁移，使脉冲期间折射率的瞬态降低拉伸内部驻波、将强度腹点推向薄膜内部；同时，随着能量密度升高，等离子体消光抑制内部反射，使吸收机制从共振主导转变为等离子体屏蔽，从而为激光纳制造中的深度分辨改性提供物理基础，并可用于界面分离与三维集成光子制造等应用。

title: Design and synthesis of laser inscribed flexible Bragg gratings containing silicon oxynitride-doped silicon thin film for authentication applications with the insights from X-Ray Absorption Spectroscopy and Quantum Mechanical Calculations
abstract: Silicon-on-insulator is mostly the main driving material system for the field of silicon photonics, including PICs, due to high index contrast and compatibility with current semiconductor manufacturing processes [1]. A recent example is silicon oxynitride-doped silicon [2] discovered recently by our group, offering to set a new position for the fields of silicon photonics with a precise control of refractive index from 2.1 to 2.5 together with the photosensitivity property at different wavelengths. In this study, we demonstrate that the synthesis of silicon oxynitride-doped silicon can be performed on a flexible substrate for the fabrication of Bragg gratings (BG) at low temperatures below 100 degrees Celsius that are emerging for advanced applications. Their use in preserving ultra-fast lasers inscribed micro-information has been demonstrated numerically and experimentally due to its multispectral reflection behaviour from the ultraviolet (UV) to the near-infrared (NIR) regions. The unique structural characteristics of silicon oxynitride-doped silicon were studied at the Si L, O K and N K edges using soft X-ray absorption studies. The quantum mechanical calculations provide the potential formation mechanism of SiON-doped Si, whereas the crystal structure prediction for bulk Si3N4-xOx was conducted using the particle swarm optimization method in combination with density functional theory (DFT).

summaries.en: The paper reports the low-temperature synthesis on flexible substrates of silicon oxynitride-doped silicon enabling laser-inscribed flexible Bragg gratings for authentication, supported by multispectral (UV–NIR) reflection performance and investigated via soft X-ray absorption and quantum-mechanical modeling to elucidate structural formation mechanisms.
summaries.zh: 论文在柔性基底上实现了二氧氮化硅（SiON）掺杂硅材料的低温制备，用于激光刻写的柔性布拉格光栅并面向身份认证，其紫外至近红外的多谱段反射性能通过软X射线吸收与量子力学计算进行表征与结构形成机制阐释。

title: All-Dielectric Tight-Binding Photonics via a Band-Gap Vacuum
abstract: Tight-binding photonics bridges condensed-matter physics and optics, providing a powerful framework for engineering band structures and topological phases with light. For photons, however, the vacuum is gapless, so resonators in air carry radiative tails that produce spurious long-range couplings. Here we embed resonators in a photonic band-gap vacuum (BgV), a photonic crystal whose band gap plays for photons the role vacuum plays for bound electrons. The BgV localizes each resonance exponentially, so designed short-range couplings define the lattice Hamiltonian. We thereby experimentally realize a faithful Benalcazar-Bernevig-Hughes Hamiltonian in an all-dielectric photonic crystal, resolving corner resonances and their orbitals in microwave measurements. Unlike the vacuum surrounding electrons, the BgV is itself designable, controlling relative couplings and closed-loop interference through its band dispersion and Bloch modes. Full-wave calculations and extracted models show that uniformly modifying the BgV, with all resonators fixed, switches the quantized polarization of a two-dimensional Su-Schrieffer-Heeger lattice and converts a zero-flux lattice into a $\pi$-flux one. We also numerically realize three-dimensional pyrochlore and hyperhoneycomb lattices with space groups $R\bar{3}m$ and $C2/c$, the latter a nodal-loop semimetal with topological drumhead surface states. These results establish the BgV as a designable vacuum for all-dielectric tight-binding photonics in two and three dimensions.

summaries.en: The paper introduces a band-gap vacuum photonic crystal that exponentially localizes dielectric resonances so short-range tight-binding couplings faithfully implement higher-order and flux-tunable topological lattice Hamiltonians, experimentally and numerically realizing models like the Benalcazar–Bernevig–Hughes system and 2D/3D topological photonic lattices by designable modification of the vacuum.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种带隙真空的光子晶体，通过指数级局域化介质谐振器来抑制长程辐射耦合，从而以可设计的方式实现高阶与通量可调的拓扑紧束缚光子晶格；作者在微波实验与数值计算中分别实现了如 Benalcazar–Bernevig–Hughes 等模型，并构建了二维与三维的拓扑光子晶格。

title: High-Efficiency Silicon-Lithium Niobate Grating Coupler enabled by Fully-Etched Subwavelength Structures
abstract: A new approach of silicon-lithium niobate (Si-LN) grating couplers (GCs) with a fully-etched structure is proposed. The coupling strength is engineered through subwavelength structures, allowing improved directionality. The adjoint-based inverse design method is simultaneously adopted to achieve efficient coupling between photonic circuits and fibers. Considering the birefringence of LN, the proposed Si-LN GCs are optimized and fabricated for TE mode along the crystallographic Z and Y directions. The experimentally measured coupling efficiencies are -3.3 dB and -3.9 dB along the crystallographic Z and Y directions, respectively. The measured 3-dB bandwidths are broader than 54 nm and the back reflections can be suppressed down to -15 dB over 50 nm for both directions. The proposed Si-LN GCs are realized by only single-step Si etching, offering a practical solution for fast device prototyping in Si-LN photonic integrated circuits.

summaries.en: The paper presents fully-etched, subwavelength-engineered silicon–lithium niobate grating couplers using adjoint inverse design to efficiently couple photonic chips to fibers for TE modes along LN’s Z and Y axes, achieving measured efficiencies of -3.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一种采用亚波长结构工程化耦合强度的全刻蚀硅-铌酸锂（Si-LN）光栅耦合器，并结合基于伴随法的逆向设计在考虑LN双折射的情况下实现沿晶轴Z与Y方向TE模的高效光纤耦合，实验测得耦合效率分别为-3.

title: Study of non-uniformity-induced structured spectrum in a tapered optical fiber through stimulated four-wave mixing
abstract: Tapered optical fibers offer tunable dispersion and a small mode area, yielding high nonlinearity, which makes them ideal for nonlinear and quantum optics. Because phase-matched four-wave mixing strongly depends on dispersion, the taper diameter becomes a key parameter. For sub-micrometer tapers, identifying the exact diameter is challenging. Here, we show that when seeding with a broad spectrum, stimulated four-wave mixing yields a comb-like spectrum that is directly linked to the overall taper profile opening possibility for non-destructive evaluation of sub-micron taper. Our model based on joint-spectral amplitude includes the phase accumulated over the fiber length.

summaries.en: The paper shows that in a tapered optical fiber, stimulated four-wave mixing seeded with a broad spectrum produces a comb-like structured spectrum whose spacing and features are tied to the fiber’s overall taper profile, enabling non-destructive determination of sub-micron taper diameter using a joint-spectral-amplitude model that accounts for phase accumulation along the length.
summaries.zh: 论文表明，在光纤锥形结构中以宽谱作为种子进行受激四波混频时，会得到与锥形整体轮廓直接相关的梳状结构光谱，并借助考虑光纤长度上相位累积的联合光谱幅度模型实现对亚微米锥径的无损评估。

title: Optical vortex bullets with large angular momenta
abstract: We investigate three-dimensional spatiotemporal optical vortex solitons (light bullets with a toroidal shape) carrying higher-order orbital angular momentum in Kerr media with anomalous group-velocity dispersion and a transversely localized Gaussian profile of the linear refractive index. Stationary vortex bullets with topological charges (winding numbers) $1\leq \ell \leq 4$ are obtained as numerical solutions of the three-dimensional nonlinear Schrödinger equation, and their existence, structure and stability are systematically analyzed. In terms of atomic Bose-Einstein condensates, these solutions represent matter-wave solitons with embedded vorticity. We examine the dependence of the solution families on the propagation constant, the depth and width of the guiding profile, and $\ell $. It is found that the increase of $\ell $ requires one to use a stronger or wider waveguiding potential to sustain localized states satisfying the Vakhitov-Kolokolov (VK) stability criterion. VK-complying and non-complying branches of vortex-soliton families are separated by a degenerate Townes branch. Direct simulations reveal that, although the guiding profile substantially suppresses the collapse and extends the propagation distance of vortex bullets, their robustness is ultimately limited by azimuthal instabilities, whose growth is enhanced for values of $\ell $. These results demonstrate that engineered refractive-index landscapes significantly enlarge the stability domain of spatiotemporal vortex bullets and provide guidelines for supporting optical bullets carrying large orbital angular momenta.
subjects: Optics (physics.optics) ; Quantum Gases (cond-mat.quant-gas); Pattern Formation and Solitons (nlin.PS)

summaries.en: The paper numerically studies three-dimensional spatiotemporal optical vortex “bullets” in Kerr media with anomalous dispersion, finding stationary solitons with topological charges 1–4 whose existence, structure, VK stability, and azimuthal-instability–limited robustness depend on propagation constant, waveguide depth/width, and orbital angular momentum, with refractive-index engineering significantly expanding the stable domain for large OAM states.
summaries.zh: 论文在Kerr介质的反常群速度色散下对三维时空涡旋“光子子弹”进行数值研究，获得拓扑电荷1–4的驻定孤子，并系统分析其存在性、结构、满足/不满足VK稳定准则的分支划分及由方位不稳定最终限制的鲁棒性随传播常数、导光势深度/宽度与轨道角动量增加的变化，同时表明经工程化折射率景观可显著扩大携带大OAM时空涡旋子弹的稳定区域。

title: Self-Oscillating Photonic Frequency Comb for Sub-THz Local Oscillator Generation in Earth Observation Systems
abstract: Earth observation missions rely on microwave and sub-terahertz radiometry for retrieving atmospheric parameters such as temperature, humidity, and cloud properties, with the 183- and 229-GHz spectral regions being particularly relevant. Local-oscillator (LO) generation at these frequencies requires low phase noise and high frequency stability while meeting stringent size, weight, and power (SWaP) constraints. Conventional architectures employ dielectric resonator oscillators followed by cascaded frequency-multiplication stages, requiring dedicated generation chains for different frequency bands and increasing hardware complexity. Furthermore, frequency multiplication degrades the phase noise of the generated signal. This work proposes and numerically investigates a reconfigurable self-oscillating microwave photonic architecture for LO generation in Earth observation receivers. Cascaded Mach-Zehnder and phase modulation within an optoelectronic feedback loop generate an optical frequency comb with enhanced higher-order components. A combination of optical filters is used to select the required comb line. First, a conventional bandpass filter with a bandwidth of approximately 10 GHz isolates the spectral region containing the desired component, after which a narrowband dual cavity Bragg grating ring resonator (BGRR) with a bandwidth of approximately 3 MHz provides the final line selection. The selected comb line is then combined with an optical reference derived from the same laser and photodetected to generate the desired millimeter-wave or sub-terahertz signal through optical heterodyning. Numerical simulations are presented for 183- and 229-GHz generation, demonstrating the ability of the same underlying architecture to address multiple LO frequencies by tuning the OEO electrical filter to the appropriate oscillation frequency and selecting the corresponding comb order.

summaries.en: The paper numerically investigates a reconfigurable self-oscillating microwave photonic integrated architecture that generates low-phase-noise 183- and 229-GHz local oscillators for Earth observation by producing an enhanced optical frequency comb via Mach-Zehnder/phase modulation feedback, filtering out a selected comb line with optical filters, and using optical heterodyning for millimeter-wave or sub-THz generation.
summaries.zh: 本文通过数值研究一种可重构的自振式微波光子集成架构，用于为地球观测接收机生成低相噪的183 GHz与229 GHz本振：利用马赫-曾德尔与相位调制的光电反馈回路产生增强高阶分量的光频梳，再用光学滤波器选取目标梳线，并通过光学拍频得到毫米波或次太赫兹信号。

title: Parameter-efficient neural computing with programmable photonic meshes
abstract: Memory capacity and bandwidth are becoming major constraints in neural-network computing, motivating parameter-efficient representations that reduce model storage and data movement. Tensor-network methods already enable substantial compression of neural networks, but their structured operations are often poorly matched to conventional processors optimized for dense linear algebra. Such representations can be implemented in photonic hardware, although this typically requires optical architectures tailored to a particular factorization. Here we propose a different approach based on programmable photonic meshes. Compact electronic parameters determine the interferometer phases, while optical interference produces a dense, generally high-rank transformation. Since the parameterization remains electronic, its dimensionality and structure can be changed without modifying the optical circuit. Numerical experiments in end-to-end training demonstrate that the proposed photonic layers match or outperform strongly compressed tensor-train and brickwork layers, often with fewer trainable parameters. Experiments in parameter-efficient fine-tuning of a language model also show advantages over established digital adapters. The reduced trainable state lowers persistent memory requirements and offers the potential to reduce data movement and bandwidth demands.

summaries.en: The paper proposes programmable photonic meshes that use compact electronic parameters to set interferometer phases while photonic interference implements dense transformations, enabling parameter-efficient end-to-end-trained neural layers that match or outperform compressed tensor-network baselines and improve over digital adapters in fine-tuning, thereby reducing trainable state and persistent memory/bandwidth demands.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种可编程光子网格方法：用紧凑的电子参数设定干涉仪相位，而由光学干涉实现一般的稠密变换，从而在端到端训练中得到的参数高效神经层在效果上可与甚至优于强压缩的张量网络基线，并在语言模型的参数高效微调中优于既有数字适配器，降低了可训练状态与持续存储/带宽需求。

title: Spatiotemporal spherical Gaussian pulses
abstract: We describe a class of electromagnetic Gaussian modes with spherical spatiotemporal structure that remains invariant during propagation through anomalously dispersive media. The angular profile of the modes is given by spherical harmonics, whose quantization axis can be freely chosen. As a result, the modes support spatiotemporal orbital angular momentum (OAM) configurations with longitudinal and transverse components set by the orientation of the quantization axis. Superpositions of these modes generalize the familiar solution of a chirped pulse that simultaneously focuses and compresses to arbitrary angular structure. The modes are derived through a series of unitary transformations that map the dispersive paraxial wave equation onto a Schrödinger equation with a 3D isotropic harmonic potential. These transformations facilitate the identification of conserved operators for mixed longitudinal and transverse OAM.

summaries.en: The paper introduces a family of spherical spatiotemporal Gaussian electromagnetic modes that keep their form while propagating in anomalously dispersive media, enabling freely oriented spatiotemporal OAM with longitudinal and transverse components and deriving them via unitary mappings to a 3D isotropic harmonic-oscillator Schrödinger model to identify conserved mixed-OAM operators.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一类在异常色散介质中传播时保持不变的球形时空高斯电磁模，并利用可任意选择的量子化轴用球谐函数构建其时空OAM，使得纵向与横向分量由该取向决定；作者进一步通过一系列幺正变换将色散旁轴波动方程映射到带三维各向同性简谐势的薛定谔方程，从而推广了可聚焦并压缩的啁啾脉冲解并识别出混合纵横OAM的守恒算符。

title: Single-Mode Laser Arrays with Size-Invariant Loss Discrimination
abstract: In conventional coupled oscillator lattices and laser arrays, expanding the active volume inevitably causes spectral crowding and degrades spatial uniformity, posing a long-standing barrier to high-power single-mode operation. We uncover a dissipative selection mechanism in sparse star networks that decouples modal selectivity from lattice size constraints. By engineering dissipative auxiliary couplings between a central hub and N peripheral resonators, the system establishes an exact star-Laplacian symmetry. This enforces a target eigenstate that is immune to all lossy channels while maintaining equal amplitude across all main nodes. All competing eigenstates break this symmetry, driving the auxiliary loss and opening a persistent, size-independent modal loss gap that prevents multi-mode competition. Realistic microring simulations validate the robustness of this dark-state isolation under electromagnetic dispersion and mechanism extension to arbitrary arrays is allowed when meets the system's exceptional point. By exploiting graph topology to bypass multi-mode competition, this work establishes a general route toward scalable high-power single-supermode laser arrays and robust state selection in coupled non-Hermitian systems.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a dissipative auxiliary-coupling scheme in sparse star networks that uses an exact star-Laplacian symmetry to isolate a single dark eigenstate immune to loss, creating a persistent size-independent modal loss gap that enables scalable high-power single-supermode laser arrays despite spectral crowding.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一种在稀疏星形网络中通过耗散辅助耦合构建的方案：利用精确的星拉普拉斯对称性隔离一个对损耗免疫的暗态本征态，从而形成持续且与尺寸无关的模态损耗间隙，使高功率单超模激光阵列在谱拥挤下仍可规模化，并通过微环仿真验证其稳健性。

title: Revealing Detailed Transport Mechanisms in Silicon Tunneling Diodes
abstract: Understanding carrier transport in heavily doped semiconductor junctions is essential for developing next-generation tunneling devices for cryogenic electronics and steep-slope technologies. In this work, we investigate the transport mechanisms in a silicon tunneling diode using extensive TCAD (Technology Computer Aided Design) simulations benchmarked against electrical measurements over a wide temperature range of 4 K to 440 K. The measured device characteristics show no negative differential conductance, strong temperature dependence of forward current with a nearly constant semi-logarithmic slope, and weak temperature dependence under high reverse bias. To identify the mechanisms underlying these characteristics, we investigate the contributions of band-to-band tunneling (BTBT), trap-assisted tunneling (TAT), Shockley-Read-Hall (SRH) recombination, and avalanche generation. We also enhance the Schenk TAT model by incorporating Fermi-Dirac statistics to accurately capture the transport behavior at lower temperatures. Under forward bias, TAT in the depletion region dominates the current at low-to-moderate voltages, whereas SRH becomes increasingly significant at higher voltages and temperatures. Under reverse bias, TAT dominates at low reverse voltages, particularly near and above room temperatures, whereas BTBT becomes predominant at high reverse bias, resulting in weak temperature dependence. This work provides a comprehensive understanding of the bias- and temperature-dependent transport mechanisms in silicon tunneling junctions and an enhanced TAT model suitable over a broader range of operating conditions.

summaries.en: The paper uses extensive TCAD simulations benchmarked to measurements from 4–440 K to disentangle bias- and temperature-dependent transport in a silicon tunneling diode, showing TAT dominance in different forward/reverse regimes with SRH and BTBT contributions where appropriate and improving the Schenk TAT model via Fermi–Dirac statistics for better low-temperature accuracy.
summaries.zh: 论文通过将4–440 K范围内的实验测量与广泛TCAD仿真进行基准对照，解析硅隧穿二极管中与偏置和温度相关的输运机制，表明在不同正/反偏区间TAT占主导，SRH与BTBT在相应条件下发挥作用，并通过引入费米-狄拉克统计改进Schenk TAT模型以提升低温准确性。

title: Leaky-Wave Antenna for Non-Invasive Continuous Glucose Monitoring
abstract: Non-invasive continuous glucose monitoring requires sensing techniques capable of delivering stable, accurate, and real-time quantification of glucose-induced dielectric variations. This paper presents a microwave-based methodology that employs a leaky-wave antenna (LWA) to launch localized traveling electromagnetic waves and estimate glucose concentration through phase measurements at a fixed operating frequency. The LWA architecture enhances electromagnetic coupling with the material under test through controlled energy leakage, enabling strong linearity and high phase sensitivity within the physiological permittivity range (relative permittivity 68-70). In vitro measurements using fetal bovine serum-glucose samples demonstrate a total phase shift of 8.51 degree across glucose concentrations from 50 to 255 mg per liter. Preliminary in vivo experiments conducted on two human subjects show strong correlations between measured S11 phase and reference glucose levels (r=0.939 and r=0.906), confirming the potential of the LWA-based sensing mechanism to track dynamic glycemic variations in a proof-of-concept setting. These results highlight the potential of the proposed approach for practical, continuous, and non-invasive glucose monitoring.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a microwave leaky-wave antenna method that non-invasively estimates glucose concentration from phase measurements of localized traveling waves, showing strong in vitro linear phase response and preliminary in vivo correlations with reference glucose levels.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出一种基于微波漏波天线的非侵入式方法，通过测量局部行进电磁波的相位来估计葡萄糖浓度，结果显示体外相位响应具有良好线性并且在初步人体实验中与参考血糖水平有较强相关性。

title: Terabit-scale wavelength-multiplexed transmitter enabled by thin-film lithium tantalate
abstract: Artificial-intelligence systems face a growing data-movement bottleneck and require higher interconnect bandwidth without a proportional increase in electrical power consumption or the number of laser sources and fibre connections. Moving optical interfaces closer to computing chips reduces electrical transmission loss, while demanding optical engines that combine high channel capacity, broadband modulation and simple packaging. Although wavelength multiplexing relieves pressure on the fibre budget, integrating shared multi-wavelength sources with dense wavelength routing and broadband modulation in a compact format remains challenging. Here we demonstrate a monolithic transmitter that brings these functions together on a single material platform, enabled by the low birefringence and native Pockels response of thin-film lithium tantalate. The device separates, independently modulates and recombines eight wavelength channels between one optical input and output. This architecture retains a two-fibre interface as the channel count grows, directly addressing the packaging burden of parallel optical links. Measurements across the eight channels establish an aggregate line rate of 1.6 Tbit s$^{-1}$. Operation with a shared optical frequency comb achieves an estimated net data rate of 0.58 Tbit s$^{-1}$ across four channels, demonstrating compatibility with a common multi-wavelength source. Scaling this architecture into multiple wavelength-multiplexed engines offers a path towards 10 Tbit s$^{-1}$ optical interfaces with high bandwidth per unit package edge, positioning thin-film lithium tantalate for the next generation of co-packaged optical interconnects.
