summaries.zh: 该论文提出并验证了一种基于薄膜铌酸锂的单片集成光学波分复用发射机：在同一平台上对8个波长通道进行独立分离、调制与重合，在信道数扩展时仍保持双光纤接口，其8通道聚合线路速率达到1.

title: Designing Robust Quantum Gates
abstract: For given control channels, quantum control theory determines whether quantum gates can be realized, but not their resilience to errors. We address this problem by establishing existence criteria for robust gate implementation in $d$-level systems. Our criteria reveal that implementability of all gates is not enough: a universal family of robust gates exists if and only if the driven Hamiltonians share no common symmetry. When these criteria hold, we can make gates resilient to any combination of static perturbations, uniform Hamiltonian rescaling, perturbations at a finite set of selected frequencies, and perturbations with arbitrary selected waveforms. We can impose robustness conditions broadly with limited information about errors, e.g., against any static perturbations; we can also tailor these conditions to the platform, e.g., against environment-induced noise with dominant spectral peaks, requiring no spectral details beyond the peak frequencies. We numerically construct explicit protocols for robust gates, reducing average gate infidelity by approximately two to seven orders of magnitude under Hamiltonian perturbations and environment-induced noise. Together, our existence criteria and numerical constructions provide practical guidance for evaluating the potential of quantum platforms and designing robust quantum gates.

summaries.en: The paper derives existence criteria for implementing error-resilient universal quantum gate families in d-level systems—showing universality of robust gates is possible iff the available driven Hamiltonians have no common symmetry—and demonstrates that under these conditions gates can be made robust against broad classes of perturbations (including arbitrary waveforms and frequency-selective noise) with explicit numerical protocols that reduce average gate infidelity by roughly 2–7 orders of magnitude.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了在d能级系统中实现鲁棒量子门的存在性判据，指出只有当所用驱动哈密顿量不存在共同对称性时，才可能构造鲁棒通用门族，并在满足条件时使量子门对多类扰动（包括任意波形和有限频率选择的扰动、以及由环境噪声主导且仅需峰值频率信息的噪声）具有很强鲁棒性，同时给出数值构造的具体协议，使在哈密顿量扰动与环境诱导噪声下的平均门保真度损失降低约2–7个数量级，从而为量子平台评估与鲁棒量子门设计提供了实用指导。

title: Quantum error correction well below the color code threshold
abstract: Quantum error correction enables scalable fault-tolerant quantum computation by suppressing logical errors exponentially with code distance once physical error rates fall below a critical threshold. Here we demonstrate below-threshold operation of triangular color codes with distances $d=3,5,$ and $7$ on Quantinuum's Helios trapped-ion quantum processor. Leveraging both circuit- and hardware- level leakage reduction schemes, we achieve logical error rates as low as $5_{-2}^{+4}\times 10^{-6}$, and demonstrate error suppression by over an order of magnitude, $\Lambda=12_{-2}^{+3}$, with each successive increase in code distance. Moreover, we demonstrate below threshold scaling of error rates for Clifford two-qubit randomized benchmarking circuits when encoded in $d=3,5$ color codes, achieving logical error rate of $7^{+3}_{-3}\times 10^{-5}$ per logical two-qubit Clifford at distance $5$ with a suppression factor of $\Lambda=9_{-3}^{+8}$. We compare logical performance for existing near-optimal algorithmic decoders, and both convolutional neural network and transformer-based neural network decoders capable of real-time decoding an order of magnitude faster than the syndrome extraction rate. These results approach the logical error rates required for megaquop-scale quantum computation and indicate that scaled trapped-ion processors could reach application-relevant performance with substantially smaller code blocks than indicated by previous results in other qubit modalities.

summaries.en: The paper experimentally demonstrates below-threshold quantum error correction with triangular color codes (d=3,5,7) on Quantinuum Helios, achieving millikelv-scale logical error rates as low as ~5×10⁻⁶ and showing strong distance-dependent error suppression, along with below-threshold scaling for encoded randomized benchmarking and comparisons of advanced ML-based fast decoders approaching megascale requirements.
summaries.zh: 该论文在Quantinuum Helios上对三角形彩色码（d=3,5,7）实现了低于阈值的量子纠错实验，获得了最低约5×10⁻⁶量级的逻辑错误率并验证了随距离增强的显著抑制效果，同时还对编码后的随机基准（randomized benchmarking）给出了低于阈值的缩放，并对比了新近的快速ML解码器，其性能接近兆规模量子计算所需指标。

title: Performance of a Hot Rb Vapour-Based Portable Quantum Memory
abstract: Quantum repeaters will be paramount to the success of the future quantum internet. Presently however, the losses incurred in fibre communications are unsustainable when fragile quantum states are transmitted over long distances. The most effective repeater nodes will require incorporation of a minimum of two quantum memory units (QMems) for successful operation. Therefore a network composed of numerous nodes will ideally require scalable repeaters that contain QMems that are portable, robust and do not require a high amount of overhead. Here we investigate the performance of a commercial QMem based on a warm vapour of Rb atoms. Specifically, we characterize the coherence time, absolute efficiency, signal to noise ratio and bit error ratio of this device over a range of vapour temperatures that are readily controllable. For our system, we place these performance metrics into the same conventions as those established for current optical communication protocols. Development of QMem systems meeting these benchmarks will be a vital step for seamless integration of QMems systems into present-day communication architectures.

summaries.en: The paper evaluates a commercial hot Rb-vapour portable quantum memory by measuring coherence time, absolute efficiency, signal-to-noise ratio, and bit error ratio across controllable vapor temperatures, benchmarking the device against current optical-communication conventions to support scalable quantum repeater deployment for a future quantum internet.
summaries.zh: 论文通过在可控铷原子热蒸汽温度范围内测量相干时间、绝对效率、信噪比和比特误码率，评估一种商业热Rb蒸汽便携式量子存储器，并依据现有光通信规范对其性能进行基准测试，以支撑面向未来量子互联网的可扩展量子中继节点落地。

title: Trajectree - A quantum trajectory-based quantum circuit simulator
abstract: We introduce Trajectree, a quantum trajectory-based quantum circuit simulator that uses a novel, state-saving partial execution of the quantum circuits to simulate broad and deep noisy quantum circuits efficiently. Trajectree can efficiently generate a large number of Monte Carlo samples by saving partially executed trajectories. We conduct extensive performance analysis of the Trajectree approach, proving the utility of the trajectory saving scheme for simulations of open quantum systems. Using this architecture, we show that Trajectree can simulate standard benchmark noisy circuits over five times faster than Google's QSim, a part of the Cirq package. We also analyze Trajectree's performance for simulating quantum optical systems relevant to communication and computing applications. We demonstrate applications of the optical backend to simulate three optical experiments: CHSH Bell test, entanglement swapping, and optical CNOT gate. This shows Trajectree's potential for simulating noisy qudit and optical systems efficiently.

summaries.en: Trajectree is a quantum-trajectory-based simulator that uses state-saving partial execution to efficiently run large Monte Carlo samples and accelerate noisy quantum circuit simulation, including optical systems and experiments, achieving over fivefold speedup versus QSim while demonstrating optical simulations such as CHSH Bell tests, entanglement swapping, and an optical CNOT gate.
summaries.zh: Trajectree 是一种基于量子轨迹的模拟器，通过保存状态的分段执行来高效生成大量蒙特卡洛样本并加速噪声量子电路仿真，借此在与 QSim 相比实现超过五倍的速度提升，同时还能对通信与计算相关的光学系统及实验进行模拟，例如 CHSH 贝尔测试、纠缠交换以及光学 CNOT 门，展示其对有噪声淬粒子和光学系统的高效仿真潜力。

title: Probing wetting and solidification dynamics of neon thin films with a high-$T_c$ superconducting circuit
abstract: Integrating condensed noble gases with superconducting circuits offers new opportunities for operating hybrid quantum devices. In particular, electrons on solid neon have recently emerged as exceptionally coherent charge qubits, however the growth of the underlying neon films on patterned devices remains poorly controlled. We monitor neon films near the triple point using a multimode resonator fabricated from high-$T_c$ YBCO, which remains superconducting at temperatures where the liquid phase exists and whose geometry sets a thickness-sensing window near 1 $\mu$m. In the liquid state we observe rich film dynamics: uniform wetting that saturates near 20 nm, drainage of thicker films, and spontaneous thickness oscillations, reflecting the extreme sensitivity of thick films in this regime. A galvanic connection to our sensing volume enables in-situ electrostatic tuning of the liquid film thickness. Statistics of freezing the neon across various liquid levels reveal variations of the solid film thickness by approximately an order of magnitude. We also observe a two-fold increase in the quality factor of the resonators at the level of $10^3$ with added neon and rule out dielectric loss as the limiting factor. Our results demonstrate that hermetic packaging facilitates the investigation of both rich non-equilibrium fluid dynamics and the impact of condensed noble gas films on microwave loss in superconducting circuits, but may not be the best modality for growing solid neon films with precisely controlled thickness.

summaries.en: Using a high‑T_c YBCO multimode superconducting resonator to sensitively probe neon thin films near the triple point, the study reveals complex wetting, drainage, and spontaneous thickness oscillations in the liquid, enables in‑situ electrostatic tuning and shows ~order‑of‑magnitude variability in frozen solid thickness, while adding neon improves resonator quality factor by about twofold without attributing the limit to dielectric loss, demonstrating hermetic packaging’s value for hybrid quantum device studies but not for precisely controlled solid‑neon thickness growth.
summaries.zh: 该研究用一台在接近三相点附近可高灵敏度探测氖薄膜的高T_c YBCO多模超导谐振器，揭示了液态下润湿、排液与自发厚度振荡等复杂动力学；同时通过与感测体积的电偶连接实现液膜厚度的原位静电调控，并发现结冰后的固态氖膜厚度变化约一个数量级；另外在加入氖后谐振器品质因数提升约两倍且排除介电损耗为限制因素，表明使用密封封装有助于研究非平衡流体动力学及凝聚惰性气体膜对超导电路微波损耗的影响，但可能不利于获得厚度精确可控的固态氖薄膜生长。

title: Optimal robust single-qubit gates in superconducting quantum processors
abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computing requires high-fidelity quantum gates that are resilient to control errors and device imperfections. Here, we develop energy-optimal control pulses for single-qubit gates that are simultaneously robust against frequency detuning and waveform inhomogeneities while also suppressing leakage outside the computational subspace. Combining the optimized pulse envelopes with an adaptive control scheme, we experimentally demonstrate optimal robust gates on a superconducting quantum processor. For a gate duration of 90ns, we achieve fidelities above 99.9% for the X gate and 99.6% for Hadamard-type gates. For the X gate, we maintain fidelities above 99.5% for simultaneous drive-amplitude variations up to 20% and qubit detuning up to 4 MHz. This robustness outperforms that of conventional Gaussian pulses by an order of magnitude, without much difference in peak gate fidelity. These results establish a route towards robust single-qubit control in large-scale quantum processors, advancing the development of fault-tolerant quantum computing.

summaries.en: The paper presents experimentally validated, energy-optimal control pulses for superconducting processors that yield robust, leakage-suppressing single-qubit gates against frequency detuning and waveform inhomogeneities, achieving >99.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了用于超导量子处理器的能量最优控制脉冲，用于实现同时抵抗频率失谐与波形不均匀、并抑制计算子空间外泄漏的鲁棒单比特门；在90 ns内实验实现X门保真度>99.

title: Ergotropy of nonequilibrium steady states beyond the full secular approximation
abstract: Understanding the generation and activation of ergotropy, the maximum work extractable by cyclic unitary operations, is central to quantum battery research. Positive-temperature thermal states are passive, whereas nonequilibrium environments can sustain nonpassive steady states with nonzero ergotropy. However, the full secular approximation commonly used in Lindblad descriptions can suppress steady-state coherence and obscure its contribution to ergotropy. Using a Bloch-Redfield master equation beyond the full secular approximation, we investigate the ergotropy of the nonequilibrium steady state (NESS) of two exchange-coupled qubits connected to independent thermal reservoirs. The NESS ergotropy of two qubits with the same frequency is entirely coherent and grows quadratically with temperature bias near equilibrium. In contrast, detuned qubits can exhibit incoherent ergotropy. We derive an exact analytical criterion for its activation and show that activation requires the hotter reservoir to be coupled to the qubit with the higher bare frequency. Comparing NESSs obtained with and without full secularization reveals quantitative and qualitative differences in ergotropy that reflect changes in both its coherent and incoherent contributions. The results clarify the mechanisms of NESS ergotropy activation and demonstrate the importance of retaining steady-state coherence beyond the full secular approximation when characterizing stationary work resources.

summaries.en: The paper shows that when modeling two exchange-coupled qubits coupled to separate thermal reservoirs beyond the full secular approximation, the resulting nonequilibrium steady-state ergotropy can be purely coherent for equal qubit frequencies and scales quadratically with temperature bias near equilibrium, while detuning can produce incoherent ergotropy, with an exact activation criterion determined by which reservoir couples to the higher-frequency qubit.
summaries.zh: 该论文表明，在超越“完全久期近似”的Bloch-Redfield框架下对两台与各自热浴相连的交换耦合量子比特建模时，产生的非平衡稳态（NESS）戈尔托皮（ergotropy）在相同比特频率情形下可完全由相干贡献并在接近平衡时随温差呈二次增长，而失谐则可能引入非相干戈尔托皮，并推导出精确的激活准则：只有当更热的热浴耦合到更高本征频率的比特时才发生激活；同时比较是否做完全久期化还揭示了相干与非相干两部分对戈尔托皮的定量与定性差异。

title: Concatenated continuous-drive protection of exchange-based spin-qubit gates
abstract: Exchange-based two-qubit gates in semiconductor spin qubits are sensitive to low-frequency detuning noise and control errors. Here, we extend concatenated continuous driving (CCD), implemented by phase modulation of a global microwave drive, to exchange-based SWAP and $\sqrt{\mathrm{SWAP}}$ operations between double-dressed spin qubits and investigate its effectiveness for protecting two-qubit gates. We find that CCD retains strong protection against quasistatic common-mode detuning errors while substantially improving robustness against Rabi-frequency errors and qubit-to-qubit Rabi-frequency mismatch compared with conventional continuous dressing. By contrast, the gate fidelity is impacted by differential detuning errors. By modeling partially correlated quasistatic detuning noise, we further show that the noise-averaged gate fidelity depends strongly on the spatial correlation of the qubit-frequency fluctuations, with positive correlations enhancing CCD protection by suppressing the differential-noise component. These results identify the symmetry and spatial correlation of qubit-frequency noise as key factors governing continuous-drive protection in coupled spin-qubit systems.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall)

summaries.en: The paper extends concatenated continuous driving (CCD) via phase-modulated global microwaves to protect exchange-based SWAP and √SWAP operations between double-dressed spin qubits, showing strong robustness to quasistatic common-mode detuning while improving sensitivity to Rabi-frequency errors and mismatches versus conventional dressing, with gate fidelity mainly limited by differential detuning whose effect—and thus noise-averaged performance—depends strongly on the spatial correlation of qubit-frequency fluctuations.
summaries.zh: 本文将通过相位调制的全局微波实现的串联连续驱动（CCD）扩展到双“dressed”自旋量子比特之间的交换型SWAP与√SWAP操作，用以提升抗低频去谐和控制误差能力，结果表明CCD对准静态共模去谐保持强保护，并显著改善相对常规连续“dressing”对Rabi频率误差及比特间Rabi频率不匹配的鲁棒性，而门保真度主要受差分去谐误差影响，且在对部分相关的准静态去谐噪声建模后，噪声平均保真度强烈取决于量子比特频率涨落的空间相关性，正相关通过抑制差分噪声分量而增强CCD保护，从而指出噪声的对称性与空间相关性是耦合自旋量子系统中连续驱动保护的关键因素。

title: Collective Strong Quantum Mpemba Effect in Accelerated Quantum Detectors
abstract: Collective coupling to the Minkowski vacuum allows uniformly accelerated quantum detectors to exhibit a strong quantum Mpemba effect, in which a state initially farther from equilibrium relaxes faster than a closer one. We establish the existence of this effect for every fixed finite number of detectors $N\geq 2$ at sufficiently small transverse separation within the pointlike secular master equation. The mechanism originates from two reflection sectors whose populations are conserved by the leading collective dynamics. Weak intersector transfer at finite separation generates an isolated, parametrically slow relaxation mode. A simple family of initial states permits its leading-order cancellation by matching the equilibrium sector populations, while a corrected preparation eliminates the slow-mode amplitude exactly. We construct a reference state that establishes a genuine reversal of trace-distance ordering. Numerical calculations and local-rate-preserving controls identify the collective origin of the effect, while spatially smeared detector calculations support its persistence within the second-order secular framework. The same mechanism extends to detectors coupled to a common thermal field, with analytically distinct slow relaxation rates. Thus, strong Mpemba relaxation is not exclusive to acceleration but emerges from a more general interplay between collective dissipation, reflection-sector conservation, and weak symmetry-breaking transfer.

summaries.en: The paper shows that uniformly accelerated quantum detectors with collective coupling to the Minkowski vacuum can exhibit a strong quantum Mpemba effect, where an initially more nonequilibrium state relaxes faster due to conserved reflection-sector populations and a weak symmetry-breaking intersector transfer that creates and can be canceled/controlled via specially prepared initial states, with numerical and smeared-detector checks confirming persistence and an extension to common thermal fields with distinct slow rates.
summaries.zh: 论文表明，具有对闵可夫斯基真空的集体耦合、并作匀速加速的量子探测器能够出现强量子 Mpemba 效应：由于反射扇区的人口在主导集体动力学下守恒以及扇区间的微弱对称性破缺转移会产生可由特定初态制备抵消/控制的慢弛豫模，因而更远离平衡的初态会比更接近平衡的初态更快弛豫；文中通过数值计算与保持局域速率的控制验证该效应的集体来源与在二阶世俗近似中的稳健性，并将机制推广到耦合同一热场的情形且给出解析上不同的慢弛豫率。

title: Adiabatic controlled-$Z$ gate for neutral atoms with Förster-enhanced Rydberg dressing
abstract: We study an adiabatic controlled-$Z$ (CZ) gate for neutral atoms in which dipole-dipole coupling between nearly degenerate Rydberg pair states enhances the interaction between dressed ground states. This coupling produces an avoided crossing in the two-atom dressed-state spectrum. Approaching the crossing enhances the dressed interaction, but also reduces the dressed-state gap and increases the Rydberg admixture. We identify a Förster-enhanced operating range in which the required conditional phase is accumulated with adiabatic return and small transient Rydberg population. We then analyze the finite-time dynamics of the two-qubit computational states under a smooth pulse. Reducing the dressing strength weakens the dressed interaction, so maintaining the target phase at the same pulse duration requires operation closer to the avoided crossing, where the Rydberg admixture increases. This dependence is then used to select the shortest gate at a fixed peak Rabi frequency in the Förster-enhanced operating range that accumulates the CZ phase with high Bell-state fidelity while keeping the Rydberg population small. Changing the Förster defect shifts the avoided crossing, while the gate parameters change only weakly. For a specific rubidium Förster channel, the selected gate corresponds to experimentally relevant laser coupling, pulse duration, and interatomic separation. We also estimate errors from the finite Rydberg lifetime and from weak excitation of a neighboring spectator atom. For the parameters considered, the spectator-induced error remains below the finite-lifetime contribution.

summaries.en: The paper proposes an adiabatic controlled-Z gate for neutral atoms using Förster-enhanced Rydberg dressing that creates an avoided crossing in the two-atom dressed spectrum, enabling high-fidelity phase accumulation with small transient Rydberg population and analyzed finite-time dynamics, error sources, and experimentally relevant parameters for rubidium.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了一种基于福斯特增强的里德堡微调（Rydberg dressing）的中性原子绝热受控-Z（CZ）门方案：通过几乎简并的里德堡对态之间的偶极-偶极耦合在双原子受控谱中形成避免交叉，在保证绝热回程与较小瞬时里德堡占据的同时积累所需条件相位，并进一步分析了平滑脉冲下的有限时间动力学、不同微调强度下的最优门时间选择、误差来源及以铷为例的实验可实现参数。

title: Symmetry-breaking chelation enables room-temperature all-optical spin coherence readout of aqueous Cu(II) for chemoselective discrimination
abstract: Optical initialization and readout of molecular electron spins in water remains challenging for 3d transition-metal complexes. Their Laporte-forbidden d-d transitions yield weak transition dipole moments, so optical spin detection in aqueous Cu(II) previously required ~1 M concentrations. Here we overcome this constraint through symmetry-breaking chelation. Coordinating Cu(II) with EDTA imposes a non-centrosymmetric ligand field with enhanced metal-ligand covalency, relaxing Laporte restrictions and amplifying d-d transition dipole moments. This design enhances absorption and magnetic circular dichroism by 7.3- and 5.6-fold, enabling ultrafast spin readout down to 100 {\mu}M with an apparent dephasing time T2^*~0.54 ns. As a proof-of-concept for selective molecular-spin sensing, histidine addition extends T_2^* to ~0.8 ns in a concentration-dependent manner, whereas glycine produces no measurable effect. These results show that symmetry breaking provides a strategy to create molecular spin-photon interfaces, opening avenues toward all-optical, analyte-responsive quantum sensing in water.

summaries.en: The paper shows that symmetry-breaking chelation of aqueous Cu(II) with EDTA creates a non-centrosymmetric ligand field that boosts weak d-d optical transition dipoles, enabling room-temperature all-optical, ultrafast spin readout at 100 μM and analyte-dependent T2* modulation (histidine increases while glycine does not).
summaries.zh: 论文通过EDTA对水溶Cu(II)进行对称性破缺螯合，构建非中心对称配体场以增强原本很弱的d-d光学跃迁偶极，从而实现室温下100 μM浓度的超快全光自旋读取，并展示T2*对分析物的依赖调控（组氨酸提高而甘氨酸无可测影响）。

title: Chiral Floquet Selection of an Algebraic Rydberg Bound State in the Continuum
abstract: Bound states in the continuum (BICs) remain localized despite the presence of extended modes at the same energy. In driven systems with long-range couplings, the absence of radiation does not by itself determine how a bound state decays in space. We study a Hermitian Rydberg spin waveguide coupled to a four-site plaquette, where a winding drive phase combines rotation with time translation to forbid propagating guide channels in one symmetry sector. The resulting eigenstate remains embedded in the continuum of other sectors and carries an inverse-cube waveguide amplitude, with coherent contributions from direct plaquette--guide coupling and long-range guide propagation. Pair-state calculations determine the microscopic couplings in the axial geometry, while coherent Floquet mixing sets the weight of the dominant circulating plaquette mode. The bound state thus retains the spatial signature of the long-range coupling even when radiation is forbidden.

summaries.en: The paper shows that in a Hermitian, driven Rydberg spin-waveguide with a four-site plaquette, a chiral Floquet drive can forbid radiation in one symmetry sector yet still yield a continuum-embedded bound state whose wavefunction has an inverse-cube spatial signature set by long-range couplings and coherently mixed plaquette contributions.
summaries.zh: 论文证明，在由四点方形（plaquette）耦合的、由手性Floquet驱动的赫米特Rydberg自旋波导中，尽管驱动相位的对称性机制能在某一对称部门禁阻传播通道并禁止辐射，仍会产生嵌入连续谱的束缚态，其空间波函数保留由长程耦合决定的反立方幅度特征，并由直达耦合与远距离导波的相干贡献共同塑形。

title: On the Complexity of Level-Synchronized Tree Automata for Quantum Circuit Verification
abstract: Reliable quantum computation requires methods for verifying quantum circuits. Level-synchronized tree automata (LSTAs) were recently introduced to represent sets of quantum states for this purpose. We study LSTAs along two axes relevant to verification: the complexity of their decision problems and the size of their representations under circuit operations. We prove that acyclic LSTAs have NP-complete nonemptiness and $\Pi_2^P$-complete language inclusion, and that general language inclusion is EXPSPACE-complete. We further prove inherent quadratic representation growth under individual quantum gates in a fixed qubit order, and give an adjacent-qubit reordering construction that preserves level synchronization. These results clarify the scope of applicability of the automata-theoretic toolbox for quantum circuit verification.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Formal Languages and Automata Theory (cs.FL)

summaries.en: The paper analyzes the complexity and representation growth of level-synchronized tree automata used to represent quantum state sets for quantum circuit verification, proving NP-complete nonemptiness, _2^P-complete language inclusion for acyclic automata, EXPSPACE-completeness for general inclusion, and showing unavoidable quadratic representation growth under gate application along with an adjacent-qubit reordering method that preserves level synchronization.
summaries.zh: 该论文研究用于量子电路验证的“层同步树自动机”在复杂度与表示规模方面的表现，证明无环自动机的非空性为NP完全、语言包含为_2^P完全，而一般语言包含为EXPSPACE完全，并表明在固定比特顺序下逐门应用会导致不可避免的二次表示增长，同时给出一种保持层同步的相邻比特重排构造。

title: \textit{In situ} certification of multiparticle indistinguishability in a generic interferometer
abstract: We propose a scalable and efficient \textit{in situ} method for assessing the multiparticle indistinguishability of identical bosons or fermions in quantum interference experiments on linear interferometers by harnessing quantum parallelism and the bunching/anti-bunching tendencies of these particles. The proposed certification method can be applied to any generic linear interferometer. For particles occupying distinct input ports of a Haar-random unitary interferometer, the number of experimental runs required to attain a prescribed statistical precision is polynomial in the number of particles, the interferometer size, and the inverse precision, with high probability. Our method is robust under losses: for uniform particle losses, the polynomial scaling is preserved when the inverse single-particle survival probability is polynomially bounded. Our scheme is especially suitable for certifying the indistinguishability of single photons in large-scale interference experiments, such as Boson Sampling in the regime of quantum advantage over classical computation.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Mathematical Physics (math-ph); Atomic Physics (physics.atom-ph)

summaries.en: The paper presents a scalable in situ certification scheme for multiparticle indistinguishability of identical bosons or fermions in any generic linear interferometer, requiring a number of experimental runs that scales polynomially with particles, interferometer size, and inverse desired precision (with high probability) and that remains robust to uniform losses, making it well suited for large-scale single-photon indistinguishability tests such as Boson Sampling.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一种可扩展的原位方法，用于在任意通用线性干涉仪中对相同玻色子或费米子的多粒子不可区分性进行在场认证，其所需实验重复次数在高概率下对粒子数、干涉仪规模和所需精度的倒数呈多项式标度，并且在均匀损耗存在时标度仍可保持，从而特别适用于大规模单光子不可区分性检验，例如量子优势条件下的玻色取样。

title: Topological Quantum Gates on FCIs with Bounded Quantum Geometry
abstract: Two-band 2D fractional Chern insulators (FCIs) have recently been shown, in principle, to admit unusual anyonic order, associated with Bloch Hopfions localized in momentum space. Here we show that bounding the integrated quantum metric along one primitive Brillouin-zone cycle may refine this topological order to $|C|$ distinct braiding observables, cyclically permuted by lattice translations, for Chern numbers $|C| > 1$. The cyclic structure entails mildly non-abelian braiding phases and otherwise matches the spectral flow exhibited by the FCI's hybrid Wannier states, with the metric bound equivalently a bound on the states' real-space spread. We give a classification of quantum gates in principle implementable on this topological order; among them we find the non-Clifford T-gate and the non-Clifford entangling CCZ-gate. This points to novel pathways to fault-tolerant quantum processes within the known orbital structure of FCIs, potentially informing experimental searches towards hardware for future topological quantum computers.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Strongly Correlated Electrons (cond-mat.str-el); Mathematical Physics (math-ph)

summaries.en: The paper shows that imposing a bound on the quantum geometry of two-band 2D fractional Chern insulators refines their Bloch-hopfion anyonic order for |C|>1 into |C| translation-cyclically permuted braiding observables and classifies the resulting gate set, including non-Clifford T and CCZ gates, enabling new routes to fault-tolerant topological quantum processing in FCIs.
summaries.zh: 论文表明，通过对二维两能带分数量子霍尔绝缘体（FCI）的量子几何施加约束，可在 |C|>1 时把与动量空间布洛赫霍皮昂相关的任何子有序细化为 |C| 个被晶格平移循环置换的编织观测量，并对该拓扑有序下可实现的门集进行分类，包含非克利福德 T 门和 CCZ 门，从而为FCI 的拓扑容错量子处理提供新的路径并为未来拓扑量子计算硬件的实验探索提供参考。

title: Multiplicative Noise in Nanolaser Amplification: From Discrete Emission Events to the Additive-Noise Limit
abstract: Laser amplification kicks off with just a few photons in the cavity, a regime where standard additive Langevin noise cannot capture the real fluctuations. To understand how this amplification begins, we map out a single-mode photon-carrier model that links macroscopic lasers directly into nanolasers. Stationary rate equations reveal that stimulated emission takes over across a tight pump window. In nanolasers, however, spontaneous processes coexist across a much broader range. Because steady-state averages miss the individual events that lead to the macroscopic photon number, we frame the stochastic dynamics around the actual discrete transitions, deriving a state-dependent diffusion approximation. The destruction of an excited carrier concurrent with the generation of a photon creates a negative photon-carrier cross-correlation. This unavoidably leads to a correlated, multiplicative Gaussian-noise framework. We track the resulting discrete dynamics with an established, event-based Laser Markov Chain (LMC) which stochastically samples pump, relaxation, emission, and cavity-loss events keeping all physical quantities as non-negative integers. Comparing its predictions to those of our multiplicative model proves that the latter reproduces excellently well the statistical behavior of photons and carrier, as long as a continuous diffusion description holds. Once the emission drops into the few-photon regime, however, the discrete model becomes indispensable. On the other hand, at large photon counts relative fluctuations shrink to a level where the state-dependence of the diffusion matrix can be ignored, to leading order, thus returning to the classic Langevin description of the system's stochastic dynamics.

summaries.en: The paper develops a discrete event-based and state-dependent multiplicative-noise model for nanolaser amplification starting from few-photon conditions, showing how stimulated emission and broader spontaneous processes produce negative photon–carrier correlations and thus multiplicative Gaussian noise that matches the full Laser Markov Chain results in the diffusion-valid regime but requires fully discrete dynamics in the few-photon limit and reduces to standard Langevin noise at large photon numbers.
summaries.zh: 本文从少光子起步的放大过程出发，建立离散事件与基于状态的乘性噪声模型来描述纳米激光放大，指出受激发射在窄泵窗主导而自发过程在更宽范围并存，由此产生光子—载流子负相关并形成乘性高斯噪声框架；与Laser Markov Chain 的离散采样结果对比表明，在扩散近似适用的区域乘性模型能很好复现光子与载流子的统计，而当发射进入少光子极限时必须依赖全离散模型，且在高光子数下相对涨落变小可忽略扩散矩阵的状态依赖，从而回到经典Langevin 噪声描述。

title: A Dual-Uplink Dual-Satellite Architecture for Entanglement Distribution
abstract: Satellite-based quantum links are a promising enabler of long-distance entanglement distribution, overcoming the exponential losses of optical fibers. In uplink architectures, entangled photons are generated at ground stations and transmitted to orbiting satellites, reducing space-segment complexity but introducing significant atmospheric and geometric losses. Single-satellite dual-uplink configurations are additionally limited by the requirement of simultaneous visibility between both ground stations and the satellite. In this work, we investigate a dual-uplink dual-satellite network architecture and compare its performance with the single-satellite scheme under identical physical assumptions. The proposed topology introduces an inter-satellite link (ISL) that decouples the ground-station separation from the atmospheric uplink geometry. A realistic channel model is employed, incorporating geometric attenuation, atmospheric turbulence, background noise, and Bell-state measurement efficiency. The overall success probability and practical fidelity are evaluated as functions of satellite altitude and ground-station separation. Our results show that while the single-satellite configuration is suitable for regional-scale networks, it becomes infeasible for large separations due to geometric constraints. The proposed dual-satellite architecture mitigates this limitation and significantly extends the achievable communication distance, representing a key step toward scalable quantum internet infrastructures.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Networking and Internet Architecture (cs.NI)

summaries.en: The paper proposes a dual-uplink dual-satellite entanglement-distribution network with an inter-satellite link to decouple ground separation from atmospheric uplink geometry, using a realistic quantum-channel model to show improved success probability and fidelity over single-satellite dual-uplink schemes and demonstrating that the new architecture enables significantly larger communication distances suitable for scalable quantum internet infrastructure.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种双上行双卫星的纠缠分发网络架构，通过卫星间链路将地面站间距与大气上行几何解耦，并在结合几何衰减、大气湍流、背景噪声和贝尔态测量效率等真实信道模型的基础上，比较并证明其在成功概率与实际保真度上优于单卫星双上行方案，从而显著延长可实现通信距离并推动可扩展量子互联网基础设施发展。

title: Multi-path Security in Quantum Networks with Trusted Nodes
abstract: Quantum communication networks promise information-theoretic security but this security collapses if intermediate relay nodes are compromised, a risk that grows sharply when compromised nodes cannot be identified. We address this twofold: first, we show that multi-path routing provides quantifiable protection against unidentified compromised nodes. Second, we provide a comprehensive statistical and graph-theoretic analysis of network and node security under compromise, covering full and partial node compromise, optimal placement of additional edges via an iterative method, and comparative hacking-probability analysis across network topologies. Together, these results identify the topology and multi-path routing strategy that most improves security for a given network. We apply this framework to quantum key distribution across multiple network topologies, demonstrating a scalable route to secure, reliable quantum communication under realistic, unidentified adversarial threats, without relying on quantum memory.

summaries.en: The paper shows that multi-path routing in quantum communication networks can quantify and significantly improve security against unidentified compromised relay nodes, using statistical and graph-theoretic analyses to optimize security through edge placement and topology comparisons, and it validates the approach for multi-topology quantum key distribution without requiring quantum memory.
summaries.zh: 论文表明，在量子通信网络中采用多路径路由可对“无法识别的被攻陷中继节点”提供可量化的安全增强，并通过统计与图论分析对边的最优增设及不同拓扑的安全性进行比较优化，且在无需量子存储器的现实对手威胁下，将该框架用于多拓扑量子密钥分发以实现可扩展、可靠的安全量子通信。

title: Quantum control as renormalization group flow
abstract: The Renormalization Group (RG) establishes relations between effective descriptions of physical systems at different scales; in Hamiltonian RG, these relations induce a flow in the space of Hamiltonians. In direct correspondence, we design an RG framework for quantum control by constructing a flow in the space of time-dependent Hamiltonians. A prescribed control subspace, selected to contain only experimentally accessible terms, forms the fixed-point manifold, while the flow preserves the target unitary and monotonically reduces the Hamiltonian weight outside this subspace. Exploiting the freedom in constructing the flow, we introduce flow-equation engineering to enhance the versatility of the framework for diverse control problems, including time-periodic and open-interval smooth protocols with prescribed endpoints. We provide two disparate applications to exhibit the utility of our approach: (i) Nonperturbative Floquet engineering beyond the regime of validity of high-frequency expansions, which we demonstrate by constructing an implementable time-periodic protocol for the Haldane model; (ii) Accessible fast-forward driving from unit-fidelity counterdiabatic evolution, which we showcase for large transverse-field Ising chains away from the adiabatic regime by compressing the long-range multibody adiabatic gauge potential into the original time-dependent Ising control schedules. Our control RG framework reveals a unifying perspective on Hamiltonian engineering and unitary quantum control, and can serve as an organizing principle behind seemingly disparate nonequilibrium quantum dynamics.

summaries.en: The paper develops an RG-inspired framework for quantum control by defining a flow over time-dependent Hamiltonians that preserves a target unitary, makes experimentally accessible terms a fixed-point manifold, and monotonically suppresses weights outside it, enabling flow-equation engineering and demonstrated applications including nonperturbative Floquet control for the Haldane model and fast-forward counterdiabatic driving for large transverse-field Ising chains.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种类重整化群的量子控制框架：在时变哈密顿量空间构造流，使其保持目标幺正变换、把仅包含实验可实现项的控制子空间定义为不动点流形，并单调压低该子空间外的哈密顿量权重，同时通过流方程工程扩展到时间周期与指定端点的平滑协议，并以哈德兰模型的非微扰Floquet控制及大横场伊辛链的快速前驱反对角演化为例展示该方法的有效性。

title: Sidewall Metrology Protocol for Superconducting Qubit Devices
abstract: Sidewall morphology is a potentially important factor influencing superconducting qubit performance, yet its quantitative characterization remains challenging due to the absence of standardized measurement protocols. In this work, we develop a scanning probe microscopy-based measurement framework for the quantitative characterization of superconducting qubit sidewalls. The framework introduces a refined root mean square lateral sidewall roughness descriptor and a new curvature-equivalent radius for quantifying vertical sidewall morphology. The descriptors and measurement procedures are applied to different components of qubit devices, forming the basis of a proposed sidewall characterization protocol. This provides a foundation for quantitative comparisons of fabrication processes across laboratories, enabling future investigations of correlations between sidewall geometry and qubit performance.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a scanning-probe-microscopy measurement framework with new roughness and curvature-equivalent descriptors to quantitatively characterize superconducting qubit sidewall morphology and enable standardized, cross-laboratory comparisons linked to qubit performance.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种基于扫描探针显微镜的测量框架，并引入改进的均方根侧壁粗糙度描述符和新的曲率等效半径，用于对超导量子比特器件侧壁形貌进行定量表征，从而为跨实验室的工艺对比及其与量子比特性能的关联研究奠定基础。

title: Two-qubit cryo-CMOS control of a spin register in diamond
abstract: Utility-scale quantum technologies will not only require a well-performing quantum platform, but also classical control hardware that is scalable, efficient, and meets the design requirements set by the quantum system of interest. One approach is the application of silicon CMOS technology, a highly scalable and mature technology, to design application-specific integrated circuits (ASIC) that are optimized for the quantum system. In this work, we present two-qubit control of electron and nuclear spins in NV centres in diamond, using a cryogenic CMOS qubit controller integrated with a diamond quantum device in a cryostat. Using Gate Set Tomography (GST) we characterize the performance of the single-qubit gates on both electron- and carbon nuclear spins, and analyze the limiting noise processes. We use dynamical decoupling to engineer a two-qubit gate, and estimate $F_\text{2q,avg} = 95(2)\%$ for the electron-nuclear two-qubit gate fidelity. Our demonstration of cryo-CMOS-driven two-qubit gates is a key step towards highly-integrated quantum devices based on colour centres.

summaries.en: The paper reports two-qubit control of NV-center electron and carbon nuclear spins in diamond using a cryogenic CMOS qubit controller, characterizing single-qubit gate performance with gate set tomography, engineering a two-qubit gate via dynamical decoupling, and achieving an estimated average electron–nuclear two-qubit fidelity of 95(2)%.
summaries.zh: 本文展示了用集成在低温恒温器中的低温CMOS量子控制器对金刚石NV中心电子与碳核自旋实现双量子比特控制，并通过门集遥测表征单量子比特门性能、分析噪声限制机制，利用动态解耦构造双量子比特门，估计电子-核双量子比特平均保真度为95(2)%。

title: Giant Rydberg Excitons Delineated as Relativistic Bound States
abstract: We examined the energy-momentum relationship of the valence band of Cu$_2$O, which has gained interest as an emerging solid host for giant Rydberg states. Our findings reveal a nonparabolic dispersion, described using the rest mass (0.570 times the free electron mass) and rescaled light speed ($1.6\times 10^5$ m/s), which draws parallels with relativistic theory for high-energy particles. We propose a straightforward expression for the bound-state energies of Rydberg excitons with finite quantum defects, whose energy scheme deviates from the hydrogenic series. This formulation identifies relativistic kinematics as the physical origin of quantum defects, offering a streamlined basis for future studies on complex many-body correlations.

summaries.en: The paper analyzes the nonparabolic valence-band dispersion of Cu2O and, by modeling its Rydberg-exciton bound states as relativistic kinematics, derives an expression including finite quantum defects that explains deviations from the hydrogenic energy series.
summaries.zh: 论文分析Cu2O价带的非抛物色散，并通过将巨型Rydberg激子束缚态视为“相对论性运动学”，推导出包含有限量子缺陷的能级表达，从而解释其相对氢样能级序列的偏离。

title: End-to-End Optimization of Partial Fault Tolerance in Neutral-Atom Arrays
abstract: Fault-tolerant (FT) quantum computation offers a pathway to quantum advantage, but its realization is hindered by its significant overhead. The partially FT "STAR" architecture reduces the cost of universal computation at the price of relaxing FT requirements for non-Clifford operations, increasing exposure to hardware noise. Therefore, maximizing its performance and applicability demands careful co-design with the underlying hardware. In this work we investigate the co-design of the STAR architecture with neutral-atom platforms, connecting the underlying atomic physics to logical error modeling and application-level performance. At the physical level, we identify a favorable noise bias in $^{171}\mathrm{Yb}$ Rydberg gates, and show how it can be enhanced through error-selective pulse optimization. At the logical level, we identify an intrinsic error suppression mechanism, yielding vanishing logical coherent noise in leading order. Detailed circuit-level simulations of surface code implementations show more than an order of magnitude reduction in logical error relative to previous estimates. As a concrete target application, we focus on the Fermi-Hubbard model with periodic boundaries, for which we design a simulation circuit particularly suited to early implementations. We quantify the resource tradeoff of partially and fully FT approaches to gate synthesis, with the former showing approximately an order of magnitude reduction in state-injection depth, and an even larger reduction in Clifford resources. Comparing with classical and fully FT approaches, we identify regimes where partial fault tolerance provides both lower overheads and lower error rates. In our estimates, this is accessible with moderate error rates $p\sim 10^{-3}$ and a few thousand qubits, underlining that for these types of problems, partial FT approaches provide a compelling pathway to early quantum advantage.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Quantum Gases (cond-mat.quant-gas); Atomic Physics (physics.atom-ph)

summaries.en: The paper co-designs the partially fault-tolerant STAR quantum computing architecture with neutral-atom platforms by linking atomic-physics noise modeling to logical error suppression, demonstrating noise-bias–enhanced Yb Rydberg gates via pulse optimization, order-of-magnitude logical error reductions in surface-code simulations, and favorable resource/error tradeoffs for early Fermi-Hubbard simulation where partial fault tolerance can outperform both classical and fully fault-tolerant approaches at moderate error rates and a few thousand qubits.
summaries.zh: 本文将部分容错的STAR架构与中性原子量子平台进行协同设计，通过将原子物理噪声建模与逻辑错误抑制关联，证明可通过误差选择的脉冲优化增强^{171}Yb莱德伯门中的噪声偏置，并在表面码电路级仿真中实现相对既有估计的逻辑错误降低一个数量级以上，同时针对具有周期边界的费米-哈伯模型设计了适合早期实现的模拟电路，量化比较了部分与完全容错在门综合资源上的取舍，指出在约p~10^{-3}的中等错误率和少量几千量子比特条件下，部分容错在开销与误差方面都可能优于经典方案与完全容错方案，从而为早期量子优势提供了有吸引力的路径。

title: Quantum Optimal Control Primer
abstract: This is a set of detailed notes that are part of a Ph.D. Course on Quantum Control delivered at the Department of Chemistry of Seoul National University in 2014. Part of this course was also taught in the Department of Chemistry of the Friedrich Schiller University Jena. It focuses on quantum optimal control and quantum optimal control algorithms based on the gradient and extended gradient methods.

summaries.en: The paper is a set of detailed lecture notes from a 2014 Ph.
summaries.zh: 本文为一套来自2014年“量子控制”博士课程的详细讲义内容，重点介绍量子最优控制及基于梯度和扩展梯度方法的量子最优控制算法。

title: Hidden Perturbative Structure in Attosecond Streaking
abstract: Attosecond streaking is inherently multiphoton, yet we uncover a hidden perturbative structure revealing the underlying continuum--continuum angular-momentum propensity. By filtering the inversion-odd response in helium streaking data at the IR fundamental, we isolate an angular distribution dominated by the $P_1$ and $P_3$ Legendre components, whose complex coefficients yield an effective $s/d$ two-photon amplitude ratio. Multichannel, two-electron time-dependent Schrödinger equation calculations demonstrate that the characteristic Fano propensity survives electron correlation. Incorporating the experimental XUV attochirp reproduces the measured emission-edge trend, while near-threshold calculations predict resonant amplitude and phase signatures associated with the bound He $np$ Rydberg series. This symmetry- and frequency-filtering approach offers a general spectroscopic framework with potential applications to atomic, molecular, and solid-state systems where attosecond streaking is established.

summaries.en: The paper reveals a hidden perturbative structure in attosecond streaking by symmetry- and frequency-filtering inversion-odd helium responses to expose a P1/P3-dominated Legendre angular distribution whose complex coefficients define an effective two-photon s/d amplitude ratio, validated by multichannel two-electron TDSE simulations and extended to reproduce experimental attochirp trends and near-threshold resonant signatures from He np Rydberg states, providing a general spectroscopic framework beyond helium.
summaries.zh: 本文通过对氦原子在红外基频下的反演奇响应进行对称性与频率筛选，揭示阿秒甩尺（attosecond streaking）的隐含微扰结构：得到以P1与P3勒让德分量主导的角分布，其复系数给出有效的两光子s/d幅比，并由多通道双电子TDSE计算证明该Fano倾向在电子关联下依然保持，同时引入实验XUV阿托啁啾可再现实测发射边缘趋势、近阈值计算还预测与He np激发态里德伯级数相关的谐振幅度与相位特征，从而提出可推广的通用阿秒甩尺光谱框架。

title: Fast and High-Fidelity Motional-State-Preserving Transport in Optical Tweezers
abstract: Reconfigurable neutral-atom processors require rapid, high-fidelity transport of atoms between optical-tweezer sites. In finite-depth Gaussian traps, fast motion can leave residual motional excitation even when the atom reaches its destination. We develop a basis-parameterized gradient-ascent pulse-engineering (GRAPE) framework for one-dimensional transport of a single $^{87}$Rb atom. A shortcut-to-adiabaticity reference is refined using 17 trajectory parameters, with ten additional parameters providing bounded trap-depth modulation; depth affects both confinement and the inverse construction of the physical trap center. For a $12.6\,\mu$m transfer completed in only $30.5\,\mu$s, corresponding to approximately $2.75$ periods of the reference trap, the selected joint protocol achieves a ground-state infidelity of $2.41\times10^{-7}$. Because preparing an exactly pure motional ground state is experimentally challenging, we also optimize population-weighted transport for initial distributions with mean vibrational occupations $\nbar\simeq0.16$ and $1.87$, reaching same-state probabilities of about $0.99993$ and $0.9934$. Trap-depth fluctuations can further degrade transport fidelity. Robust optimization under a measurement-informed depth-noise model improves the mean error, worst sampled error, and fidelity dispersion for the specified noise realizations. Coordinated control of tweezer position and confinement thus offers a route to rapid transport with low residual excitation for flexible atom rearrangement and dynamic connectivity in neutral-atom processors.

summaries.en: The paper presents a GRAPE-based pulse-engineering framework that jointly modulates optical-tweezer position and bounded trap-depth to enable fast, motional-state-preserving transport of a single 87Rb atom with extremely low residual excitation, achieving a ground-state infidelity of 2.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一种基于GRAPE的脉冲工程框架，通过协同调控光镊位置与受限的势阱深度，实现对单个87Rb原子的快速且保持动量态的输运：在30.

title: Rydberg Atomic Receiver for Wireless Physical Layer: A Survey
abstract: With the escalating development of the quantum information technologies, the Rydberg atomic receiver has been envisioned as a promising alternative to its classical electronic counterparts, attracting extensive attentions from both physics and electronic engineering disciplines. By exploiting the electrical acuteness of Alkali atoms with diverse Rydberg energy states for electromagnetic field measurement, Rydberg atomic receiver is capable of surmounting the inherent limitations on the operating bandwidth and detection sensitivity of the classical electronic counterparts. Against this background, this article provides an extensive overview of Rydberg atomic communication and sensing from fundamental theory, critical technologies to practical implementations. Firstly, the milestones of the Rydberg atomic receiver evolution was introduced. Then we provide a clear understanding of Rydberg atomic receiver mechanisms from the perspective of classical communication and sensing, and highlight the unprecedented advantages over traditional electronic receivers as well as the technical challenges. Afterwards, necessary fundamentals are presented including the Rydberg atoms, typical non-coherent/coherent structures, and explicit experimental configurations, followed by discussions on state-of-the-art development of the Rydberg atomic receiver. Specifically, advancements on electric-field detection methods for accurate measurement of amplitude, phase, frequency and polarization, are extensively investigated. Based on the established methodologies, recent innovations in Rydberg atomic communication and sensing are reviewed, ranging from waveform design and array-based signal processing to radar applications like localization, imaging and remote sensing, with practical experimental results presented. Finally, we summarize the promising research trends around Rydberg atomic receiver.

summaries.en: This survey reviews Rydberg atomic receivers for wireless physical-layer applications, explaining their underlying principles, key technologies, experimental configurations, and advantages over classical electronic receivers for measuring electromagnetic fields, and summarizes recent advances in electric-field detection, communication/sensing methods, waveform and array signal processing, and radar functions such as localization, imaging, and remote sensing while outlining future research trends.
summaries.zh: 本文综述了用于无线物理层应用的里德伯原子接收机，阐述其基本机理、关键技术与实验配置，并讨论其在电磁场测量方面相较传统电子接收机的优势，重点总结电场探测方法、通信与感知进展，以及波形设计和阵列信号处理，并回顾定位、成像与遥感等雷达应用的最新成果与未来研究趋势。

title: Effect of Physical Barriers on High-Harmonic Generation in Liquid-Phase
abstract: High-harmonic generation (HHG) in liquid-phase systems presents fundamental differences from gas and solid phases, notably a reduction in the harmonic cutoff, its apparent independence from laser parameters, and the appearance of a second plateau. In this work, we introduce a one-dimensional quantum model that incorporates physical boundaries to simulate the effect of solvation shells in liquid water by means of a complex absorbing potential (CAP). By systematically varying the position, width, and strength of the CAP, we explore how these physical constraints influence the HHG spectrum. Our findings confirm that spatial confinement, specifically the physical truncation of electron trajectories, is the primary factor governing the cutoff in liquid-phase HHG. This confinement leads to a cutoff that is independent of laser intensity and wavelength, aligning with experimental observations and existing hypotheses proposed by Mondal et al. in 2023 and 2026. Furthermore, by implementing a semi-transparent CAP, we successfully reproduce the less intense second plateau observed in liquid-phase HHG. Time-frequency analysis confirms that this characteristic spectral feature is driven by partial wave-packet transmission through the solvation shells, which allows a surviving fraction of electrons to undergo longer continuum excursions. Our one-dimensional approach successfully isolates the fundamental role of physical boundaries in liquid-phase HHG, providing a clear and intuitive understanding of the underlying physics.

summaries.en: The paper uses a one-dimensional quantum model with complex absorbing potentials to show that physical confinement from solvation-shell–like boundaries primarily determines the laser-parameter-independent harmonic cutoff in liquid-phase high-harmonic generation and that a semi-transparent boundary reproduces the weaker second plateau via partial wave-packet transmission allowing longer electron excursions.

title: Observation and control of polariton noise in a thermal Rydberg atom electrometer
abstract: The establishment of metrics and control of fundamental noise sources in quantum sensing is a long-standing goal in quantum science and technology. We report on the observation of polariton-mediated optical noise in a thermal Rydberg atom vapor and demonstrate its active control and suppression using a radio-frequency field in Rydberg electrometry. The noise exhibits structured amplification and reduction across the Rydberg electromagnetically induced transparency resonance. This reveals a nonlinear slow-light feedback mechanism in which the polariton medium stores and releases probe-field energy. We show that the reference radio-frequency field used in Rydberg heterodyne receivers can also tune the medium into an operating regime where high electromagnetic-field responsivity coincides with reduced optical noise. This operating-point control enables optimization of the electric-field sensitivity within the constraints imposed by Rydberg-polariton physics. These results establish polariton noise as a previously unrecognized intrinsic noise source in thermal Rydberg vapors and the corresponding control method as a crucial aspect of continued efforts to achieve fundamental sensitivity limits in Rydberg electrometry.

summaries.en: The paper reports observing structured polariton-mediated optical noise in a thermal Rydberg-atom electrometer and actively suppressing and tuning it via an applied radio-frequency field to optimize electric-field sensitivity using a nonlinear slow-light feedback mechanism inherent to Rydberg polariton physics.
